fee_notes: $59,500 for single territory (~150,000 households). Multi-unit concurrent pricing: 2nd unit $40,000 ($99,500 total), 3rd $35,000 ($134,500), 4th-6th $30,000 each. Additional territory $0.40/household. Existing-business merger discounts 25-100%. 10% veteran discount available.
raw_excerpt: The Initial Franchise Fee is $59,500 for a territory of up to approximately 150,000 households.
